title: Pescadores campaign (1895)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Pescadores campaign (1895)", at revision 1370704080, opens: "The Pescadores campaign was the last military operation of the First Sino-Japanese War and an essential preliminary to the Japanese conquest of Taiwan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2583202, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1895 campaign of the First Sino-Japanese War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
